response.overview: Pattaya is remembered for its dazzling lights, but behind them lies the reality of women who sustain their lives while being labeled as “bad girls.”  This documentary views women working in bars or in sex-related jobs not as symbols of entertainment, but as workers who support their families and endure each day for a better tomorrow.  It may seem like a choice, but in truth, it is a path they were pushed into by an unequal social structure — a choice made for survival.  Through their voices, we confront the true face of Pattaya’s night: a human story caught between prejudice and reality.
response.title: Under The Palm Tree
